Recommended decisions from the synthetic test:
  • Separate task completion, validation, and reward-credit events in both data model and dashboard.
  • Keep 553 reversal rows quarantined until matched to the authoritative ledger; candidate links are not verified.
  • Track withdrawal processing time and pending age with valid lifecycle timestamps and approved amount/unit definitions.
  • Publish reward economy metrics by currency and state; do not convert VE/SVE, Gems, Tokens, XP or credits without documented, effective-dated rules.
  • Test onboarding and acquisition by cohort, platform, and source on real consented production telemetry before making product changes.
